facts: Plywood is finished in Vietnam by re-pressing and trimming imported United States plywood of heading 4412. The finished plywood is classified in 4412.31 in Japan. The US plywood is the sole non-originating input and represents 80% of FOB value. There is no proof of origin for the input.

Particleboard is machined and finished in Vietnam for Japan. Its only material is particleboard of heading 4410 made in the United States. It is non-originating under RCEP and makes up 85% of FOB value. The finished board is classified in 4410.11.

Fibreboard for a buyer in Japan is cut and edge-finished in Malaysia. The Venezuelan fibreboard used as the only material is non-originating, classified in heading 4411, and accounts for 81% of FOB. The finished good is classified in 4411.12.

Indian granite slabs, non-originating under RCEP, are squared and trimmed in Thailand for shipment to Japan. Both the only material and finished good are in heading 2516. The finished tariff code is 2516.12. The Indian stone accounts for 92% of FOB.

Mexico supplies non-originating chalk of 2509.00 to a producer in Vietnam. The sole material is milled and packaged there for export to Japan as chalk of 2509.00. The non-originating chalk accounts for 79% of FOB.

A finished synthetic-fibre blanket of 6301.40 is shipped from Vietnam to Japan. The producer re-hems US-made non-originating blankets, also 6301.40, which account for 96% of the final weight and 80% of FOB. There are no other non-originating materials or processes.

Finished curtains of 6303.92 are shipped from Thailand to Japan. Precut and already hemmed non-originating Indian curtains of 6303.92 are resized at the Thai factory. They account for 93% of the finished weight and 82% of FOB.

Non-originating rock salt mined in the United States is the sole material. A producer in Vietnam grinds and sieves it for sale to Japan as table salt of 2501.00. The input is also 2501.00 and makes up 85% of FOB.
